name: MyTVCalendar Sync
description: Automatically marks TV episodes as watched on MyTVCalendar.com when you watch them in Jellyfin.
overview: Syncs your Jellyfin watch history to MyTVCalendar.com

versions.changelog: Fix: events skipped due to the Sync Settings user filter were only logged at Debug level, making silent filtering invisible in normal Jellyfin logs. This skip is now logged at Information level.
